items.title: Widerspruch against Krankengeld denial
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 27.01.2026, sent by simple post. Per the letter's own delivery clause ('gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben') and § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: Sat 31.01.2026 (for social-law letters this deemed-delivery day does not itself shift for falling on a weekend). Counting the one-month Widerspruch period under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB (day after the delivery day is day 1) and § 188 Abs. 3 BGB (period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day), one month from 31.01.2026 lands on Sat 28.02.2026. Since that is a Saturday, § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X shifts the deadline to the next business day: Mon 02.03.2026.

warnings: This Widerspruch deadline (02.03.2026) has already passed as of today (26.09.2026); if the decision is to be challenged, seek advice on late filing or reinstatement (Wiedereinsetzung) options rather than assuming the deadline can still be met.
The letter states no monetary amount to pay; it only announces that Krankengeld will be paid starting 22.01.2026 instead of the requested 12.01.2026, so no payment amount could be extracted.
